title: demoView pulse.json (pulse_version 1), PROPOSAL
description: Proposal, not landed: parser owns schema/ and lands it. One per parse, written by the Worker's pulse consumer to parsed/{id}/{parse_id}/pulse.json after the match is ready. Jev's win probabilities and round judgments, plus the facts code computes beside them. Rounds and ticks refer to that parse's match.json; players never appear. Versioned on its own, independent of schema_version. Cross-field rules (round numbers exist in match.json, moment ticks increase and fall inside the round, swing_tick is one of the moment ticks) belong in validate.mjs.

pulse_version.description: Goes up on any breaking change to this file.

model.description: The model id Jev reported in its responses, e.g. jev-1.13.0, or fallback-logit-v1 when Jev was unavailable and the fallback model drew the line. A fallback file has highlight 0, share 0 and headline null in every round, and is left out of worth_watching. A change of model re-runs Pulse.

state_version.description: Version of the state builder and question set. Goes up when either changes, so answers from different prompts are never mixed.

parse_id.description: The parse this file belongs to; the same prefix it is stored under.

calibration.description: The recalibration applied to Jev's raw win probabilities: p_ct = sigmoid(logit(p_raw) / temperature). 1 means none.

rounds.description: One entry per match.json round that has moments. A round that ended in freeze time, such as a surrender, has none and is left out.

worth_watching.description: Up to three round numbers, highest highlight first.

moment.description: Jev's read at one moment: the round start (freeze end) first, then each in-round kill.

p_ct.description: Calibrated chance the CT side wins from here. The viewer draws this.

p_raw.description: Jev's raw noul answer, kept for self-grading.

tension.description: Jev's tension score: 0 decided, 1 leaning, 2 open, 3 knife-edge.

n.description: The n of this round in match.json rounds.

swing_tick.description: Tick of the moment with the largest change in p_ct, computed in code. Null when the round has a single moment.

highlight.description: Jev's highlight score: 0 routine to 4 instant highlight.

share.description: Jev's chance that a player would share a clip of the round.

headline.description: Jev's headline template, or null when code rejected it because its deterministic check failed.

facts.description: Computed in code from match.json and the narrative log, never asked of Jev.

clutch.description: The winning side's clutch, as 1vN at its largest, or null.

multikill.description: Most enemy kills by one player in the round.

comeback.description: The winning side was down by two or more players alive at some point.
